name: genai-vision
description: Use when the user asks to generate images with Stable Diffusion, SDXL, FLUX or a diffusers pipeline, img2img, inpainting, ControlNet, LoRA styles, or transcribe audio with Whisper. Produces model choice with license note, pipeline code, memory settings and serving outline. Not for VLM image understanding (use multimodal-pipelines) or detection models (use ml-computer-vision).
